# C: key beats packet_limit on the same packet (limit reached exactly there)
cfgC = dict(cfg, packet_limit=2)
o = run(cfgC, [{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
               {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 102},
                                           {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 60}]}])
exp = [{"events": []}, {"events": []},
       {"events": [{"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 7, "start": 0, "end": 2},
                   {"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 2, "reason": "key", "at": 2, "time": 2, "rule": 7}]}]
# C2: packet_limit fires at n=1 when nothing matched yet, later key hit cannot revise
o2 = run(dict(cfg, packet_limit=1), [{"op": "open", "flow": 1, "time": 0},
      {"op": "chunk", "packets": [{"flow": 1, "time": 1, "source": 1, "length": 102},
                                  {"flow": 1, "time": 2, "source": 0, "length": 60}]}])
exp2 = [{"events": []},
        {"events": [{"type": "decision", "flow": 1, "class": 9, "reason": "packet_limit", "at": 1, "time": 1, "rule": None},
                    {"type": "match", "flow": 1, "rule": 7, "start": 0, "end": 2}]}]
print("C2", "PASS" if o2 == exp2 else "FAIL " + json.dumps(o2))
print("C", "PASS" if o == exp else "FAIL " + json.dumps(o))
